/ What's inside

Everything you need.
Nothing you don't.

01 — Focus
25:00

Deep work, on rails.

Pomodoro presets (25/5 and 50/10), custom intervals and automatic focus and break phases. Hit start and the clock runs itself.

02 — Habits

Small actions. Every day.

A weekly grid with live streaks and a daily progress ring.

03 — Tasks

Out of your way.

Add in seconds, sort, reorder, undo. Clear the list without fighting the app.

04 — Statistics

See where the time went.

Today's Focus, weekly progress and history, so you can watch a habit grow.

05 — Themes

14 ways to make it yours.

Nebula, Borealis, Synthwave, Ember, Forest, Sakura, Mono and more, plus a custom accent and a glow slider.

06 — Local-first

Yours, on your PC.

Everything lives in a local SQLite database. Fast to open, private by design, and no cloud to wait on. Dashboard, Calendar and Notes are built in too.

Next: Events →

/ Events

EventsEvents

School and community initiatives.

01 · January 14 · Secondary School #31, Jizzakh

Defender of the Motherland Day

School President & Lead Organizer

A school-wide event for younger students marking the creation of Uzbekistan's national armed forces in 1992. I planned the program, coordinated the logistics, led the main presentations and delegated tasks to peer volunteers, turning national history into activities younger students could follow.

02 · New Year · Community service

Brightening Young Minds

Our team ran a New Year kindness drive for talented students from families facing financial hardship. Volunteers delivered gift packages with treats, supplies and food staples to their homes in person, along with encouragement for the year ahead.

03 · May 7, 2026

San'at Quvvati (Power of Art)

An evening of open-air concerts with live singers and bands, art exhibitions and interactive photo zones that brought students and guests together.

04 · Education

Jadid Bobolarimiz (Our Jadid Ancestors)

An event honoring the Jadid movement, whose figures founded modern schools, newspapers and theater in Central Asia and pushed for education and social enlightenment.

05 · Awareness · Healthy lifestyle

Say No to Drugs and Harmful Habits

An educational event promoting a healthy lifestyle among young people and warning about the harm of drugs. Students held slogans like "Stop Narko" and visited an information stand in the school hall. It also encouraged parents to talk openly with their children.

06 · Competition · English

Spelling Bee

School President & Organizer

A school spelling bee that I ran as School President. Students took turns in front of their classmates spelling English words, writing each one out on the board. To motivate everyone and encourage as many students as possible to take part, I awarded the winners cash prizes.

/ About me

Hi, I'm Shohjahon.Hi, I'm Shohjahon.

I'm a student developer from Jizzakh, Uzbekistan, with a growing focus on computer science, cybersecurity, software engineering and digital product design.

My interest in technology started with computers long before I understood programming. Over time, curiosity turned into experimentation, experimentation turned into coding, and coding turned into building complete software projects.

I enjoy working independently, learning through real projects and solving problems with whatever tools I have. Alongside technology, I have experience in student leadership, project planning, school initiatives and intellectual competitions.

I don't want to only learn how technology works. I want to build with it.
